necessary_context.content: X is a solid in R^n, meaning compact convex with nonempty interior. F:X→R∪{+∞} is closed convex and finite on int X. Opt=min_X F. Separation Oracle tests membership in int X and otherwise returns e with <e,y><<e,x> for every y∈int X. First order Oracle at an interior point returns F(x) and a subgradient. B is a solid containing X; computational evaluation assumes linear minimization over B is available.

necessary_context.content: For a finite protocol with nonempty productive index set I and complementary set J, certificate weights are nonnegative at all steps and sum to one over I only. Residual uses every step; the output average and objective-value average use I only.
necessary_context.name: Certificate and output definitions
